status: T4 UNIVERSAL-Q SUBGATE CLOSED; COEFFICIENT-JET CLASSIFICATION OPEN
scope: Fixed L=16 three-torus; six-real production Gaussian with covariance symbol bounded by a constant times <k>^-4; fixed positive rho floor inherited from A6/A7; uniformly bounded common real-even scalar approximate identities coupled through the same Gaussian modes and converging pointwise to one; exact/dealiased products; and deterministic Cameron-Martin shifts h in H^2. The theorem constructs the universal centered derivative-square tensor Q in every finite probability moment and its H^2 translation action. The A6 X/area lift is inherited. Finite scalar majorants and tensor fixtures are regression evidence, not replacements for the Fourier proof.

definitions.cameron_martin_action: tau_h Q_i^{ab}=Q_i^{ab}+partial_i h^a partial_i X^b+partial_i X^a partial_i h^b+partial_i h^a partial_i h^b.
definitions.full_product_reading: The literal full Wick products XQ and XXQ retain the low-high spectrum of Q and are not the advertised coefficient jets.
definitions.naive_nested_reading: A cone-localized subdiagram of Pi(X,Pi(X,Q)) has a fixed negative scalar coefficient whose absolute magnitude is bounded below on every dyadic scale. This requires explicit lower-chaos classification but does not prove noncancellation of the total symmetric Littlewood-Paley tree.

theorem.joint_limit: For every kappa>0 and finite p, Q_Lambda converges jointly with the inherited A6 (X,area) lift in L^p(Omega;H^(-1-kappa)); a subsequence selected from dyadic cutoffs converges almost surely.
theorem.all_moments: Q is a Hilbert-valued second Wiener chaos. Nelson hypercontractivity upgrades the Fourier-Wick L2 Cauchy estimate to every finite p, including 6/(2-kappa) in the coefficient-model application range 0<kappa<1/2.
theorem.translation: For every deterministic h in H^2, the displayed tau_h Q is well-defined in every finite L^p(Omega;H^(-1-kappa)); h maps locally Lipschitzly into this space, and coupled cutoffs R_Lambda h converge strongly for each h.
theorem.q_counterterm: Gamma_{Lambda,i}^{ab} is the only divergent Q-level local subtraction. Translation adds deterministic-linear and deterministic-quadratic terms and no new Q-level stochastic contraction.
theorem.raw_jet_no_go: Literal full XQ/XXQ fail the advertised improved L2 model regularities. A cone-localized subdiagram of the natural unnormalised nested resonant QXX tree has a fixed negative coefficient with magnitude accumulating like c log Lambda, but total-tree noncancellation is not proved. The complete coefficient-jet half of the parent model-lift gate therefore remains open.

honesty_boundary: This scoped T4 result proves the universal centered derivative-square tensor in every finite probability moment and its deterministic H^2 Cameron-Martin translation continuity. It refutes the literal full-product reading of the proposed coefficient jets and exhibits a non-absolutely-summable cone-localized contraction component, without proving noncancellation of the total symmetric resonant tree. It does not construct the renormalised first- and second-order coefficient-corrector model, prove cancellation of its lower-chaos contractions in the Class-II reconstruction, handle adapted random shifts, prove a signed stochastic form bound, bound the strong random remainder, prove the q=10/9 Nelson moment, close A7/A11, construct an interacting measure, remove the rho floor or regulator, take infinite volume, prove a phase transition or BCC selection, or justify T5, T6, or T7.
